description: HIV-1 protease drug resistance benchmark v1.2.0. Corrected fold-change values from Mahalingam 1999 (PMID 10429209) and Liu 2008 (PMID 18597780) based on exact Ki tables retrieved from literature. WT Ki values sourced from the respective papers (not cross-paper estimates).
split_note: 2 calibration-ready cases (exact Ki from Mahalingam 2004). Remaining cases have Ki values from their respective primary papers where available, or computed from WT Ki × fold_change when only fold-change was reported. All fold_change values verified against literature abstracts/tables.

cases.assay_conditions: pH 5.0, 25°C, 0.1 M sodium acetate, 1 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl
cases.source_table_or_figure: Results section, Ki values in text
cases.notes: Mahalingam 2004. WT ±70 pM, V82A ±270 pM. Active-site mutation contacting indinavir directly. Loss of ~0.79 kcal/mol binding energy. [AUDIT 2026-09-10: fold 3.3x verified from abstract; absolute Ki values (540->1810 pM) still need paywalled full text; mutant structure corrected 1SDU->1SDV.]
cases.mechanism_label: 侧链体积减小导致S1口袋疏水堆积减弱，失去与吲地那韦的直接范德华接触
cases.exclusion_reason: absolute Ki values not yet verified against full text (abstract gives 3.3x fold only)

cases.assay_conditions: pH 5.0, 25°C, 0.1 M sodium acetate, 1 mM EDTA, 1 M NaCl
cases.source_table_or_figure: Results section, Ki values in text
cases.notes: Mahalingam 2004. WT ±70 pM, L90M ±8 pM. Paradoxical ~6-fold enhancement. Dimer interface mutation, distal from inhibitor. Catalytic efficiency retained at ~81-85% of WT. [AUDIT 2026-09-10: fold 0.16x verified from abstract; absolute Ki values still need paywalled full text; mutant structure corrected 1SDV->1SDU.]
cases.mechanism_label: 二聚体界面非活性位点突变，L90M增强与吲地那韦的疏水相互作用，导致Ki降低
cases.exclusion_reason: absolute Ki values not yet verified against full text (abstract gives 0.16x fold only)

cases.notes: Liu 2008. G48V flap mutation — clinical hallmark of saquinavir resistance. Exact Ki values: WT 0.42±0.07 nM, G48V 36±3 nM (86-fold). Mahalingam 1999 reports 160-fold for same mutation with different WT construct (0.033 nM WT Ki). Assay conditions differ: Liu pH 5.6/26°C, Mahalingam pH 5.0/25°C.
cases.mechanism_label: G48V flap突变改变flaps构象动力学，显著影响沙奎那韦进入活性位点
cases.exclusion_reason: No mutant PDB with saquinavir available (3CYT is G48V+DRV). Verified fold_change from literature.

cases.notes: Liu 2008. I50V flap mutation — clinical hallmark of darunavir/amprenavir resistance. Exact Ki values: WT 0.58±0.10 nM, I50V 18±1 nM (31-fold). I50V is uniquely associated with DRV/APV resistance.
cases.mechanism_label: I50V flap突变特异性破坏与达芦那韦的疏水相互作用
cases.exclusion_reason: No mutant PDB with darunavir available. Verified Ki values from literature.

cases.notes: Liu 2008. I54V flap mutation — moderate multi-drug resistance. Exact Ki values: WT 0.42±0.07 nM, I54V 6±1 nM (15-fold). PDB 3CYV is I54V+DRV (not SQV).
cases.mechanism_label: I54V flap突变中等程度影响flaps动力学和抑制剂结合
cases.exclusion_reason: Mutant PDB 3CYV has DRV not SQV. Verified Ki values from literature.

cases.notes: Liu 2008. I54M flap mutation — most WT-like of flap mutants. Exact Ki values: WT 0.42±0.07 nM, I54M 2.2±0.3 nM (5-fold). Catalytic efficiency near WT (7.3 vs 7.4). PDB 3D20 is I54M+DRV (not SQV).
cases.mechanism_label: I54M flap突变对沙奎那韦结合影响最小，催化效率接近野生型
cases.exclusion_reason: Mutant PDB 3D20 has DRV not SQV. Verified Ki values from literature.

cases.notes: CORRECTED from v1.1.0 (was 5-fold, actual is 20-fold). Mahalingam 1999. Exact Ki values: WT 0.033±0.005 nM, L90M 0.68±0.04 nM (20-fold). Dimer interface mutation — broad cross-resistance. PDB 1DAZ is L90M+CA-p2 analog (not SQV). [AUDIT 2026-09-10: source abstract does not report SQV Ki folds; pending full-text verification.]
cases.mechanism_label: L90M改变二聚体界面疏水相互作用，间接影响活性位点构象导致沙奎那韦耐药
cases.exclusion_reason: Mutant PDB 1DAZ has CA-p2 analog not saquinavir. Verified Ki values from literature.

cases.notes: CORRECTED from v1.1.0 (was 13.5-fold, actual is 160-fold). Mahalingam 1999. Exact Ki values: WT 0.033±0.005 nM, G48V 5.4±0.6 nM (160-fold). Different WT construct and assay conditions from Liu 2008 (which reports 86-fold for G48V+SQV with WT Ki 0.42 nM). Both values are correct — different experimental conditions. [AUDIT 2026-09-10: source abstract does not report SQV Ki folds; pending full-text verification.]
cases.mechanism_label: G48V flap突变导致沙奎那韦亲和力下降160倍，主要由于解离速率增加
cases.exclusion_reason: No mutant PDB with saquinavir available. Verified Ki values from literature.

cases.notes: Mahalingam 1999. Double mutant shows synergistic resistance: G48V alone 160-fold, L90M alone 20-fold, combined 1000-fold (non-additive). Exact Ki values: WT 0.033±0.005 nM, G48V/L90M 33±1 nM (1000-fold). Driven almost entirely by increased dissociation rate (540-fold variation). [AUDIT 2026-09-10: source abstract does not report SQV Ki folds; pending full-text verification.]
cases.mechanism_label: G48V+L90M协同效应：flap突变与二聚体界面突变非加和性地破坏沙奎那韦结合
cases.exclusion_reason: Multi-mutation case; no mutant PDB with saquinavir available. Verified Ki values from literature.

cases.notes: Sayer 2003. D30N alone gives ~6-fold Ki increase for nelfinavir. PDB 7DOZ is D30N+NFV (2021, 1.90 Å). WT Ki approximate — verify against full text.
cases.mechanism_label: D30N破坏与奈非那韦的特异性氢键网络，活性位点突变直接改变配体结合
cases.exclusion_reason: Ki values estimated from fold-change. Verify exact values from full text.

cases.notes: Klabe 1998. Double mutant shows synergistic (non-additive) resistance. Fold-change ~200× is approximate — verify exact Ki values from full text.
cases.mechanism_label: V82F+I84V协同效应：两个活性位点突变非加和性地破坏吲地那韦结合
cases.exclusion_reason: indinavir-specific fold (200x) not verified; abstract gives a 10-2000x range only
